subject: Client welcome: operational readiness and kickoff checklist
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@stellarmed.com>, Samir Patel <samir@stellarmed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Client welcome: operational readiness and kickoff checklist

Hi Anna / Samir —

Welcome to Redwood — excited to kick off the StellarMed onboarding. Before the official kickoff I'd like to confirm a few operational items so the session is productive for everyone. Proposed kickoff window (pick one):

- Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred)
- Wed Apr 21, 08:00–09:00 PT (APAC-friendly alternative)

Run-of-show (45–60 min total):
- 0–10 min: Introductions and success criteria
- 10–30 min: Integration overview + sample requests (tech ops deep-dive)
- 30–45 min: Data/security checklist, SSO & network requirements
- 45–60 min: Next steps, immediate tasks, and owners

Pre-kickoff asks (please confirm):
1) Final attendee roster (names + roles).
2) Any guest constraints (recording, internal compliance) or bridge firewall rules we should be aware of.
3) Request a 15-min technical preflight window 24 hours before kickoff to validate access and test the meeting bridge.

Attachments: kickoff agenda (v1) and the signed SOW for reference.

I’ll get a calendar invite out once you confirm preferred slot and attendees.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments:
- Redwood_StellarMed_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (agenda)
- SOW_Redwood_StellarMed_signed.pdf (contract)

From: Samir Patel <samir@stellarmed.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Anna Ruiz <anna@stellarmed.com>
Cc: Harper Young <harper@consultbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Client welcome: operational readiness and kickoff checklist

Thanks Priyom — Tue Apr 20 at 10:00 PT works for us.

Attendees from our side:
- Samir Patel (Product Owner)
- Anna Ruiz (IT Ops)
- Dr. Leila Morgan (Clinical lead — will join first 20 minutes)

A couple of notes:
- We need to loop in our security contact (Harper Young) — Harper is cc'd.
- We have a corporate VPN that blocks some conference providers. Anna will send a short list of allowed domains; can you confirm the bridge provider you plan to use?
- Recording is OK, but we need it saved to our internal SharePoint.

Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Product Manager | StellarMed
samir@stellarmed.com

Subject: Re: Client welcome: operational readiness and kickoff checklist

Thanks — locking in Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:00 PT. Calendar invite is sent (link below).

Operational owners we will have on the call:
- Monica Patel — Onboarding lead (owner: overall checklist, follow-ups)
- Karthik Iyer — Technical ops lead (integration runbook, test account setup)
- Ben Carter — Customer success (adoption milestones, reporting cadence)
- Priyom Das — Implementation manager (agenda & run-of-show)

Preflight test: we propose a quick 15-minute check on Mon Apr 19 at 10:15 PT. Karthik will run the connectivity checklist:
- Verify bridge reachability from StellarMed network
- Confirm SSO / test account provisioning (if possible)
- Share sample API request and validate headers/auth

Bridge provider: we will use Redwood Bridge (Zoom-compatible SIP fallback). Anna: this should show as domains: zoom.us, redwood.ai, and aws.amazon.com — please confirm if your firewall allows these.

Recording: we can record and provide an MP4. If StellarMed requires storage to SharePoint, we'll provide a download link immediately after and coordinate upload instructions.

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Recording: We will record the meeting and provide an MP4. Priyom will upload to the shared Drive; StellaMed team can download and move to SharePoint.
